name: 710 Labs Prepackaged Flower | Banana Rickscotti
description:
Genetics: Honey Banana x Rick Jamez

There’s a reason our flower is renowned industry-wide – we never blind source. We meticulously grow our ladies in-house with wholly organic inputs, dry and cure it based on density, and trim it by hand to bring you the most opulent, flavor-dense nugs in the world. Top colas only.
